# 12 FEET — Billiard club & Gentlemen's lounge

> Bratislava, Slovakia. Two 12-foot Russian pyramid billiard tables, bar (coffee, tea, beer), online table booking.

## Official site
- https://12feet.sk/sk — Slovenčina (default)
- https://12feet.sk/en — English
- https://12feet.sk/ru — Русский
- https://12feet.sk/uk — Українська
- https://12feet.sk/de — Deutsch

## Location
Záhradnícka 36, Bratislava, Slovakia

## Opening hours
- Tuesday–Thursday: 12:00–00:00
- Friday–Sunday: 12:00–02:00

## Table rates (EUR per hour)
- Monday–Thursday: 20
- Friday–Sunday: 25

## Booking
Reservations are made on the website booking form: date, time, table 1 or 2, duration, name, phone.

## Bar menu (indicative)
Coffee: Espresso, Americano, Cappuccino. Loose tea. Bottled and draft beer.

## Contact
Use the booking form on the website. Email: info@12feet.sk
